name: Baroque chiaroscuro

media.title: Caravaggio, The Calling of Saint Matthew (1599–1600)
media.note: the paradigm case of the style

reacts_against: Mannerism's crowded, evenly lit compositions, pulling the eye to one figure with one hard light source instead.
revivals: a constant reference point for film noir and theatrical lighting design ever since

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Dramatic movement, swirling forms, monumental scale, ''chiaroscuro'' (strong light/dark contrast), religious ecstasy, martyrdom, classical mythology, elaborate ornamentation
wiki_facts.key_colours: Deep, rich colors (crimson, indigo, ochre), dramatic contrasts of light and shadow, extensive use of gold and bronze
wiki_facts.key_values: Opulence, grandeur, sensuousness, drama, movement, tension, emotional exuberance, passion

findings: dark — about 42% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 48% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
